page.notes: Reading of the Greek entries (Καρδιογνώστης, φιλανθρωπος) and of the Greek word after "meritissime" is uncertain; the last is marked [?]. Several numerals in the middle and right columns are small and smudged (e.g. 596, 966, 1064, 1019) and may be misread. Column letters are not printed on this page. The whole page is one index column set, so it is not split into headings. Two lines are clearly difficult: "impietatis ofor" (probably "impietatis ostendat") and "quibus rationibus suos feruet" (text unclear, possibly "quibus rationibus suos feruet").
